[2026-05-31 13:50] New task — CHORE-77 RED (issue #77). Task #6 is yours. This fixes a regression CHORE-76 introduced.

## The bug
The `overflow-x-hidden` you/we put on `<header>` for CHORE-76 AC7 forces `overflow-y: auto` (CSS spec), which clips BOTH dropdown panels (AvatarMenu logout + the new nav-tab-menu) — they sit `absolute top-full` below the header and get cut off. Breaks logout on desktop AND mobile. Plus header is `position: static` so the panels' `z-50` can't beat page content.

## Branch
`chore/nav-stacking-fix` is checked out in the shared tree (verify `git branch --show-current`; checkout if needed). You own it for RED. NOTE: there are some uncommitted memory-file changes in the tree (bentham.md/tallis.md/test-gaps.md) — leave those alone; only `git add` your spec file(s).

## What to write (RED — these must FAIL on current code)
Work in `src/lib/components/MvoxNav.spec.ts`:
1. **Revise the CHORE-76 AC7 test** — it currently asserts the `<header>` has `overflow-x-hidden`. That assertion encoded the BUG. Change its intent: the header must NOT have a block-axis overflow clip (`overflow-hidden` / `overflow-x-hidden`). This is a legitimate RED-phase test-intent change (the old solution was wrong), document it in your commit message.
2. **AC2 stacking** — assert `<header>` carries `relative` (or `sticky`) AND a `z-index` class (e.g. `z-30`/`z-40` — assert presence of a `z-*` utility, don't over-pin the exact number; Byrd picks the value above page content).
3. **AC3 horizontal-overflow control without clip** — assert the flexible org area keeps `min-w-0` (+ truncation) and fixed items (`nav-avatar-wrapper`, `nav-signin-wrapper`, hamburger) keep `flex-shrink-0`, so overflow is controlled by truncation, not a header clip.
4. Keep the existing 11 other responsive tests green (don't disturb them).

Tailwind layout still can't be truly asserted in jsdom — encode structurally (class presence/absence) as you did for CHORE-76. Add/extend the deferred Playwright viewport+paint-order note in test-gaps.md (the true check that the panel is visible above content).

## Gate + handoff
Run `pnpm check`, `pnpm test:unit`, `pnpm lint` (run `pnpm lint:fix` BEFORE committing per your new ritual), `pnpm build`. New/revised tests FAIL (RED), rest green. Commit spec only — atomic chaining + `MVOX_EXPECTED_BRANCH=chore/nav-stacking-fix`, no `Co-authored-by:` lines. Send me a Story Handoff with the failing summary + the data-testid/class contract for Byrd. Then idle.
